title: Session 6 · Complete every part · With checklist
description: Ten short typed responses practicing complete instructions using supplied everyday information.

definition.title: Session 6 · Complete every part · With checklist
definition.instructions: Before answering, identify every requested part. Enter them, then reread the request and check that each part is present. All information is supplied. Type only the requested words or code in the requested order, separated by spaces. Capitalization does not matter. Example format: green circle. Take a comfortable pace. You may go back to check answers before submitting.

questions.prompt: CARD: Color = blue. Shape = star. Size = large. Write the COLOR, then the SHAPE. Use only those two words.
questions.explanation: The requested parts in order are blue star. Review an equivalent response manually if formatting affected its score.

questions.prompt: LIST: apple — red; pear — green; plum — purple. Write the FRUIT that is green, then its COLOR. Use only those two words.
questions.explanation: The requested parts in order are pear green. Review an equivalent response manually if formatting affected its score.

questions.prompt: SOURCE WORDS: quiet bright soft. Write the LAST word, then the FIRST word. Use only those two words.
